Layer badges

The three data layers every answer is assembled from. Layer 1 is the graph System 1 and 2 ingest. Layer 2 is live NCBI. Layer 3 is enrichment. The colour, not the label, is what a reader learns to recognise.

Knowledge graph

L1

115M nodes, 693M edges merged from 5 NCBI databases by System 1 and 2. Queried with Cypher. Broad and fast, a periodic snapshot rather than live.

  • cypher_query
#205493

Live NCBI APIs

L2

E-utilities, Datasets and dbSNP, called at query time. Narrower and slower than the graph, and always current.

  • ncbi_efetch
  • ncbi_dbsnp
  • pathogen_detection
#2E8540

Enrichment

L3

PubTator3, LitVar2 and ClinicalTrials.gov. Literature and trial evidence layered on a fact the first two layers established.

  • pubtator_annotate
  • litvar2_lookup
  • clinicaltrials_search
#4C2C92
